# ApexDoc

> Browser-based bank statement PDF to Excel conversion for accountants, bookkeepers, businesses, and individuals.

## Primary pages
- https://apexwebdesign.online/
- https://apexwebdesign.online/pdfconverter
- https://apexwebdesign.online/allbanks
- https://apexwebdesign.online/tools/pdf-compressor
- https://apexwebdesign.online/blog

## What ApexDoc does
ApexDoc helps users convert supported bank statement PDFs into structured Excel files. Processing is designed to happen in the browser, so users can review their files before downloading the result.

## Discovery
- Sitemap: https://apexwebdesign.online/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy: https://apexwebdesign.online/robots.txt

## Crawler guidance
Public HTML pages may be crawled and cited. Do not crawl private account routes or API endpoints. API routes are excluded in robots.txt.

## Accuracy
Bank formats can change. Users should compare exported transactions with the original statement before relying on the workbook for accounting, tax, or reporting.
